reponse: The root cause was the disk filling up on Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2 after infra PR #221 removed size-based retention, leaving only 7-day time-based retention [2]. The broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC, and consumers stalled for 2h47m, until 12:25 UTC [2][4]. No events were lost because producers buffered them [2]. The earlier theory blaming PR #388's batch size change was wrong. The postmortem calls it a red herring, and reverting it changed nothing [5][3][1].
